structure_checkpoints: Landscape 1536x1024. Draw ONLY the CENTRAL SANCTUARY GROUP of Banteay Srei: THREE sanctuary prasats on their shared stepped plinth, as seen obliquely in the photographs. In Image 2 these are the two tall sanctuary towers in the BACKGROUND center-left and center; the third sanctuary behind the center/right is occluded. DO NOT draw the large gabled library buildings at front left and right or the cropped enclosure architecture. Image 3 corroborates the sculpted sanctuary forms and shared support. Keep this photographed oblique arrangement, with TWO fully visible towers and the third partly hidden; do not invent a three-in-a-row view. Preserve actual receding roof tiers, carved pilasters, doorway and curving carved pediments, existing irregular edges, whole supporting plinth in the selected group. Omit freestanding guardian statues, enclosing buildings and trees. No vast Angkor-Wat-style temple backdrop.
material_observations: 粉红至红褐砂岩、局部黑化和少量苔绿；雕饰暖红褐，门洞深褐。
source_note: 依据所列实拍进行艺术简化；范围为中央三祠塔与共同台基，遮挡关系保留，不据此宣称测绘精度。原型待用户人眼验收。
